args: Loan due dates are stored as UTC midnight of the return day.
Members can borrow at most 3 tools at once.
Overdue reminders are sent by SMS through Twilio from toolshed/sms.py.
Tool barcodes are Code 128 with the prefix TS-.
Deposits are kept in whole cents as integers.

steps.prompt: Fix double bookings when two members reserve the same tool at the same moment, in toolshed/loans.py.

calls.content:
OUT = set()

def checkout(tool_id: str, member_id: str, session=None) -> bool:
    # SELECT ... FOR UPDATE on the tool row
    if tool_id in OUT:
        return False
    OUT.add(tool_id)
    return True

steps.commit: Lock the tool row when reserving
steps.final: Reservations lock the tool's row, so two members can no longer book the same tool at once. 16 passed.
